questions.question: What are the three most important questions to ask about any Elizabethan building? (3 marks)

points.text: The three most important questions to ask about any Elizabethan building are: (1) Who built it and why? - Understanding the patron's identity, wealth, and motivations; (2) What does it tell us about Elizabethan society? - How the building reflects the values, wealth, and priorities of the period; (3) How does it connect to wider historical events? - Linking the building to themes like religion, go
